# v5.1.0

## New
- Added the call lifecycle APIs from the native Calls SDK 5.1: `initiateCall`, `endCall`, `getActiveSession`, `injectIncomingCall` and `injectIncomingCallEnded`, with `IncomingCallListener`, `InitiateCallOptions`, `InitiatedCall`, `PrepareStatus`, `SessionState`, `EndCallStatus`, `CallType` and `ReceiverType`. On Android and iOS each runs the native method of the same name, so calls ring and are prepared while they ring, and answering joins almost immediately.
- Added `leave()`, `isSessionJoined()`, `isSessionActive()`, `getSessionId()`, `getCallToken()`, `getPrepareStatus()` and `getPrepareError()` to `CallSession`.
- Added the `onConnected` and `onParticipantConnected` session events, which fire while a session is prepared and before the user joins.
- Added `SessionSettingsBuilder.setPeerCall` for 1:1 calls.
- Added `CometChatCalls.notifyCallKitAudioActivated()` and `notifyCallKitAudioDeactivated()` for iOS apps and push SDKs that own the `CXProvider`: call them from `provider(_:didActivate:)` and `provider(_:didDeactivate:)` to hand the audio session to WebRTC. They do nothing on Android and web.
- Added an example app that initialises the SDK, logs a user in and joins a session.

## Enhancements
- Moved to the native Calls SDK 5.1.0 on Android and iOS, and to the JavaScript Calls SDK 5.1.0 on web.
- Changed `connect()` to run on web as well, returning the `CallSession` with the same prepare status the native platforms report. `getCallToken()` is null on web.
- Improved Picture-in-Picture on Android: the plugin switches the call to the PiP layout when the app enters PiP and back when the window expands, and closing the PiP window keeps the call running with this user's video paused until the app is on screen again. Apps only decide when to enter PiP; apps that switched the layout themselves with `enablePictureInPictureLayout()` and `disablePictureInPictureLayout()` should remove those calls.
- Changed the Android ongoing call service to also use the `mediaPlayback` foreground service type when the app declares it and holds `FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK`, so a call answered with the microphone denied keeps its notification.
- Removed the Firebase configuration files and internal release scripts that previous versions shipped in the package.

## Fixes
- Fixed Android release builds failing with "Type com.facebook.react.bridge.Callback is defined multiple times" in apps that also use `flutter_stripe` or another package with React Native class names. The native SDK now ships its React Native runtime under its own package names.
- Fixed the app being killed on Android when a call was answered with the microphone permission denied.
- Fixed iOS voice calls switching to the loudspeaker right after joining.
- Fixed `onSessionLeft` not reaching the app on iOS when the call was ended from this device, which left the "session has ended" view on screen.
- Fixed a listener that removed itself while being notified, for example on `onParticipantJoined`, stopping the event from reaching the listeners after it.
- Fixed the iOS join reliability fixes of 5.0.10 not applying to the native 5.1 join: a join that fails or does not complete within 30 seconds reaches `onError`, a join interrupted by a brief network drop is retried, and rebuilding the call widget no longer ends the call.

## Deprecations
- Deprecated `CallSession.leaveSession()`. Use `leave()` instead.
- Deprecated `CallSession.isCallSessionActive`. Use `isSessionActive()` instead.

## Breaking Changes
- **iOS builds with Swift Package Manager only.** The native Calls SDK 5.1 is published as a Swift package, not on the CocoaPods trunk. Swift Package Manager is on by default from Flutter 3.44; otherwise run `flutter config --enable-swift-package-manager`. If it is off, `pod install` stops with these steps.
- **Android apps declare the ongoing call service.** The plugin no longer declares it, so the app chooses the foreground service types it can justify on Google Play. Apps upgrading from 5.0.x must add it inside `<application>`; without it, Android stops the microphone and camera when the app goes to the background:
  ```xml
  <service
      android:name="com.cometchatcalls.cometchatcalls_plugin.services.OngoingCallService"
      android:exported="false"
      android:foregroundServiceType="microphone|camera" />
  ```
- **iOS apps build with Xcode 26.1.1 or later**, through `connectivity_plus` 7.1+, which uses the iOS 26 SDK. With Xcode 16 the build fails with "Value of type 'NWPath' has no member 'isUltraConstrained'". An app that must build with Xcode 16 can hold `connectivity_plus` at 7.0.x in its own `pubspec.yaml` (`'>=7.0.0 <7.1.0'`).
- **Android apps need Android Gradle Plugin 8.9.1 or later and `compileSdk` 36**, through `connectivity_plus` 7 and `androidx.core` 1.18. Flutter 3.44's default `compileSdk` is 36.
- **Apps that `implements` `SessionStatusListeners` or `ParticipantEventListeners` must add the new `onConnected` or `onParticipantConnected` method**, or `extends` the class instead. Dart requires a class that implements another to define all of its members, so these apps no longer compile until they do.
- Changed `CometChatCalls.connect` to report a `CallSession` instead of a `String` status, as the native SDKs do. The old status is `session.getPrepareStatus()`.
- Changed `CometChatCalls.endCall` to report no data, and removed `EndedCall`. The native SDKs no longer return a body from `endCall`.


# v5.0.10

## New
- None

## Enhancements
- Improved iOS call reliability with automatic retries for brief network interruptions.

## Fixes
- Fixed failed iOS call joins leaving users on a black screen or calling screen without errors. Improved initialization handling and `onSuccess`/`onError` callbacks.
- Fixed recurring iOS console initialization logs during calls.


# v5.0.9

### New
- None

### Enhancements
- None

### Fixes
- Fixed call event listeners on Android only working for the first call after the app started. In apps using `androidx.lifecycle` 2.8.0 or later, subsequent calls now correctly receive End-button, session-status, participant, and media events (previously the End button did nothing and the remote peer was left connected).


# v5.0.8

### New

- None

### Enhancements

- None

### Fixes

- Improved call notifications so tapping them opens the app directly.
- Improved screen sharing setup so it is only enabled for apps that use the feature, reducing unnecessary requirements for other apps.
- Removed unused Android calling permissions and configurations.


# v5.0.7

## New
- Added call transcription and live closed captions across the JavaScript, React Native, Android, iOS, and Flutter SDKs. Added APIs to start and stop transcription, configure transcription through session and call settings, and fetch transcripts with pagination.

## Enhancements
- None

## Fixes
- Fixed an iOS/React Native build failure where WebRTCModuleOptions.h could not be found. Updated header resolution to support use_frameworks!, namespaced public headers, and bare header search paths.


# v5.0.6

## New
- Added optional iOS system Picture-in-Picture. When `enableIOSPictureInPicture` is turned on, the call continues in a system PiP window after the app is backgrounded, instead of dropping the video. This is separate from the in-app PiP layout and is off by default.

## Enhancements
- Moved the recording indicator into the header next to the call timer so it no longer covers participant tiles.
- Updated the audio mode button so its icon matches the active route (speaker, earpiece, Bluetooth, or headphones).
- Increased the connection timeout so calls have more time to connect on slower networks.
- Stopped receiving remote video while the app is backgrounded (unless iOS system PiP is active), to reduce bandwidth and battery use.

## Fixes
- Fixed `CallLogRequestBuilder` so call history can be fetched from `CometChatCalls`. It was previously unavailable on the public API, and requests could fail even when the builder was used directly.
- Fixed configured display names being overwritten by the name from the auth token.
- Restored v4-compatible `muteAudio(false)` and `pauseVideo(false)` so passing `false` unmutes audio or resumes video.
- Fixed Call UI settings being reapplied on every render, and AppState listeners stacking across remounts.
- Fixed audio devices that omit a uid so they still appear and can be selected.


# v5.0.4

> **Breaking:** the minimum supported iOS version is now 15.1 (previously 13.0). This follows the native iOS Calls SDK, whose binary requires 15.1.

### Enhancements
- Updated the underlying native SDKs from 5.0.0 to 5.0.2 on both Android and iOS. This brings across the fixes released there, including the in-call audio device menu, faster call start from preloading WebRTC, corrected audio routing (earpiece for voice calls, no forced speaker for video), and fixes for false "connection lost" messages and one-to-one calls not ending when the last participant left.
- Added SDK identification telemetry. When the Calls SDK is used standalone (without the CometChat Chat SDK present), it now reports basic SDK identification — app ID, app version, SDK version and integration source — once per login, so usage can be attributed correctly. No call content or participant data is included.

# v5.0.0-beta.3

### v4 Backward Compatibility Layer
- Added deprecated `generateToken`, `startSession`, and `endSession` static methods on `CometChatCalls` for drop-in v4 API compatibility
- Added `CometChatCallsEventsListener` deprecated mixin with all v4 event callbacks
- Added `CallSettingsBuilder.listener` deprecated setter
- Added `CallSettings.toSessionSettings()` conversion method
- Added `V4EventListenerAdapter` that bridges v5 focused listeners to v4 callbacks
- Added `RTCUser.fromParticipant` and `GenerateToken.fromCallToken` factory constructors

### iOS Native Compatibility
- Added `CometChatRTCView` ObjC stub for Chat SDK v4 `checkCallsFramework()` runtime check
- Added `setAuthToken` method channel to restore native auth state after SDK re-initialization
- Auth token is now bridged to the native iOS SDK via the deprecated `generateToken(authToken:sessionID:)` side effect

### Auth Token Bootstrapping
- Deprecated `generateToken` now calls `loginWithAuthToken` internally to bootstrap v5 SDK state
- Auth token passed by v4 consumers is cached for subsequent operations like `getUserAuthToken()` and call logs

### Barrel File
- Exported `User` class (removed `hide User` restriction) to fix example app compilation

### Example App
- Added `GIDClientID` to iOS `Info.plist` for Google Sign-In

# v5.0.0-beta.2

- Initial v5 Flutter Calls SDK with new API surface
- `CometChatCalls.joinSession` with session ID or call token
- `SessionSettings` / `SessionSettingsBuilder` replacing `CallSettings`
- Focused listener protocols: `SessionStatusListeners`, `ParticipantEventListeners`, `MediaEventListeners`, `ButtonClickListeners`, `LayoutListeners`
- `CallSession` singleton for session control
- Call logs API with `CallLogRequestBuilder`
- iOS CallKit integration
- Background call handling
- Picture-in-Picture support
